text.zh-CN:
结直肠癌是大肠的结肠或直肠发生恶性肿瘤，部分由息肉逐渐演变。

- 可出现便血、排便习惯改变、贫血或体重下降，早期也可能无症状。
- 结肠与直肠位置不同，治疗方案并不完全相同。
text.en:
Colorectal cancer develops in the colon or rectum, sometimes from polyps.

- Bleeding, changed bowel habits, anaemia or weight loss may occur; early disease may be silent.
- Colon and rectal locations lead to different treatment plans.

text.zh-CN:
风险来自遗传、既往病史和环境的共同作用。

- 年龄、家族史、林奇综合征等遗传原因不可自行改变。
- 长期炎症性肠病和既往高风险息肉需要专门随访。
- 吸烟、过量饮酒、肥胖和缺少活动属于可干预因素。
text.en:
Risk combines inheritance, history and environment.

- Age, family history and inherited conditions such as Lynch syndrome cannot be changed directly.
- Longstanding inflammatory bowel disease or high-risk polyps require surveillance.
- Smoking, excess alcohol, obesity and inactivity are modifiable.

text.zh-CN:
以下情况按急症处理。

- 持续大量便血、血块或伴晕厥要急救。
- 明显腹胀、持续呕吐、停止排气排便伴腹痛，可能是肠梗阻。
- 抗癌治疗中发热寒战或严重虚弱，按团队急症方案立即联系。
text.en:
These features need urgent action.

- Heavy ongoing rectal bleeding, clots or fainting requires emergency care.
- Pain with marked distension, persistent vomiting and inability to pass stool or gas may indicate obstruction.
- Fever, chills or severe weakness during treatment requires urgent team contact.

text.zh-CN:
有新症状不要只等下一次筛查。

- 持续排便改变、便血、不明贫血或体重下降，应预约评估。
- 黑便、暗红便或血性腹泻需更及时求助。
- 有痔疮也不能自动解释所有出血，症状持续要复查。
text.en:
New symptoms should not wait for the next screen.

- Arrange assessment for persistent bowel change, bleeding, unexplained anaemia or weight loss.
- Black or dark-red stools or bloody diarrhoea need more urgent advice.
- Known haemorrhoids do not explain every bleed; persistent symptoms need review.

text.zh-CN:
检查分为寻找病灶和确定范围。

- 粪便免疫化学检测寻找隐血，异常不直接等于癌症。
- 肠镜观察肠内并取组织活检，确认是否恶性。
- 确诊后用影像和相应分子检测帮助分期、选药；不能凭肿瘤标志物单独确诊或排除。
text.en:
Tests identify the lesion and its extent.

- FIT detects hidden blood; an abnormal result is not itself cancer.
- Colonoscopy inspects the bowel and obtains tissue for diagnosis.
- Imaging and molecular testing guide stage and treatment; tumour markers cannot diagnose or exclude cancer alone.

text.zh-CN:
常见良性问题也可相似。

- 痔疮、肛裂可出血，感染或肠易激综合征可改变排便。
- 炎症性肠病可能腹泻便血。
- 便血伴贫血或体重下降等组合需查明原因，不能仅按症状贴标签。
text.en:
Benign problems may resemble cancer.

- Haemorrhoids and fissures bleed; infection or irritable bowel syndrome changes bowel habits.
- Inflammatory bowel disease may cause bloody diarrhoea.
- Bleeding with anaemia or weight loss needs investigation rather than symptom labelling.

text.zh-CN:
治疗按位置、分期和肿瘤特征选择。

- 手术可切除病灶及相关肠段，部分患者需要暂时或永久造口。
- 化疗可在术前缩小肿瘤或术后降低复发风险；直肠癌更常涉及放疗。
- 特定晚期病例可靶向或免疫治疗，目标可能是长期控制和减轻症状。
text.en:
Treatment depends on site, stage and biology.

- Surgery removes the affected bowel; a temporary or permanent stoma may be needed.
- Chemotherapy may shrink disease or reduce recurrence; radiotherapy is more common for rectal cancer.
- Selected advanced cases receive targeted or immune therapy to control disease and symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
抗癌药有明确适应证和监测要求。

- 化疗可引起腹泻、口腔炎和血细胞下降，严重反应需及时报告。
- 奥沙利铂可能造成手足麻木和冷刺激不适。
- 靶向和免疫药依据检测选择，可能影响血压、皮肤或引起器官炎症，不可自行减量换药。
text.en:
Cancer drugs require matched indications and monitoring.

- Chemotherapy can cause diarrhoea, mouth sores and low blood counts; severe reactions need reporting.
- Oxaliplatin may cause numbness and cold sensitivity.
- Targeted or immune medicines depend on testing and can affect pressure, skin or organ inflammation; do not alter doses independently.

text.zh-CN:
治疗中的营养目标是能吃进去并避免脱水。

- 体重下降或食欲差时请营养师帮助增加能量和蛋白质。
- 术后、造口或梗阻风险者纤维与饮水建议不同，不照搬高纤维方案。
- 没有食物能消灭肿瘤，也不要断食或大量补品替代治疗。
text.en:
Nutrition maintains intake and hydration.

- Dietetic advice can support energy and protein with weight loss or poor appetite.
- Fibre and fluid advice differs after surgery, with a stoma or with obstruction risk.
- No food eradicates cancer; do not replace treatment with fasting or supplements.

text.zh-CN:
护理需适应排便和治疗变化。

- 记录排便次数、出血、体重与药物不适。
- 有造口时学习袋具、周围皮肤和脱水征象的处理。
- 逐步活动并获得心理支持，持续疼痛或进食困难要报告。
text.en:
Care adapts to bowel and treatment changes.

- Track stools, bleeding, weight and adverse effects.
- Learn stoma appliance, skin and dehydration care when relevant.
- Increase activity gradually and seek emotional support; report persistent pain or eating difficulty.

text.zh-CN:
个人背景会改变检查和治疗安排。

- 年轻患者也会患病，有症状不能因年龄小忽略。
- 家族多例或早发病例应讨论遗传咨询和亲属筛查。
- 老人、孕妇或严重合并疾病者需协调选择检查及治疗强度。
text.en:
Background changes assessment and treatment.

- Young adults can develop cancer; age does not dismiss symptoms.
- Multiple or early family cases warrant genetic counselling and relative screening discussions.
- Older, pregnant or medically complex patients need coordinated testing and treatment decisions.

text.zh-CN:
复查目的是识别复发、新病灶和治疗后问题。

- 计划可包括问诊、肠镜、影像或血检，按分期和治疗安排。
- 不能用所有患者的平均预后预测个人。
- 新便血、持续腹痛、消瘦或气促应提前联系，不等例行复诊。
text.en:
Follow-up detects recurrence, new lesions and treatment effects.

- Plans may include examinations, colonoscopy, imaging or blood tests according to stage and treatment.
- Average prognosis cannot predict an individual.
- Report new bleeding, persistent pain, weight loss or breathlessness before routine review.

text.zh-CN:
局部生长和扩散会产生不同后果。

- 慢性失血可贫血，肿瘤堵塞可肠梗阻。
- 穿孔可导致腹腔感染，扩散到肝肺等影响相应器官。
- 手术和放疗也可能改变排便、性或泌尿功能，需要康复支持。
text.en:
Local growth and spread have different consequences.

- Chronic blood loss causes anaemia; blockage causes obstruction.
- Perforation can infect the abdomen, while liver or lung spread affects those organs.
- Surgery and radiation can alter bowel, sexual or urinary function and require support.

text.zh-CN:
筛查和生活方式各有作用。

- 按地区及家族风险参加筛查，适当处理癌前息肉。
- 保持活动、合适体重，戒烟并减少酒精。
- 不要自行服阿司匹林防癌：可能出血，是否适用需专门权衡。
text.en:
Screening and lifestyle serve different roles.

- Follow jurisdiction- and family-risk-based screening and appropriate precancerous-polyp care.
- Stay active, maintain suitable weight, stop smoking and reduce alcohol.
- Do not self-start aspirin for cancer prevention because bleeding risks require assessment.
